fact: On 1 June 2026 at the Abidjan 2 conference, the REFRAM and RIARC regulator networks adopted a common framework for AI in audiovisual and digital media, with labelling of deepfakes and detection duties for platforms, for transposition by member regulators.
title: Côte d'Ivoire-AIP/ Le REFRAM et le RIARC adoptent un cadre commun pour encadrer l'IA dans l'audiovisuel et le numérique
